links.outcome: Low LVEF detection performance across patient subgroups (race, sex, comorbidities)
links.effect: Patient characteristics such as race, sex, and presence of several comorbidities were associated with lower LVEF prediction performance, despite overall AUROC above 0.9 for all architectures.
links.quote: We also observed that some patient-specific characteristics such as race, sex, and presence of several comorbidities were associated with lower LVEF prediction performance.

screen.reason: Evaluates off-the-shelf deep learning architectures on ECG data for detecting low left ventricular ejection fraction and specifically assesses subgroup performance disparities across patient characteristics (demographics and comorbidities).
